r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system led by the prime minister, with the monarch as a symbol. The leader of the majority party in the House of Commons becomes prime minister, so the prime minister can change through a party leadership contest without a general election. The Conservatives and Labour have long taken turns in power, and the first-past-the-post system, which elects only the top candidate in each constituency, favors big parties. There is no constitution bound in a single document; laws and conventions serve as the constitution. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have devolved legislatures, and Scotland held an independence referendum in 2014.

t.why: A permanent member of the UN Security Council and a nuclear power, and a member of NATO and the G7. London is, with New York, a center of world finance, and investors worldwide watch the Bank of England's rate and the pound. It is the center of the Commonwealth of 56 countries, many of them former colonies, and with the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand it forms the 'Five Eyes' intelligence alliance. Since leaving the EU in 2020 it has been rewriting its trade rules and joined the CPTPP. It also forms the AUKUS security partnership with the United States and Australia.
t.rel: Since leaving the EU in 2020, it has been rewriting its trade rules. It maintains a 'special relationship' with the United States, and the Northern Ireland border was the thorniest part of its negotiations with the EU.
t.korea: The two first established relations with the 1883 Korea-Britain treaty, and Britain sent the second-largest force after the United States to the Korean War. After Brexit it signed its own free trade agreement with Korea and negotiated to expand it. Cooperation with Korean companies is growing in offshore wind, nuclear power, finance and defense. It is also a favorite destination for young Koreans studying in English or on working holiday visas.
t.know: The British monarch travels abroad without a passport, because British passports are issued in the monarch's name.
etext: London is, with New York, one of the two great centers of world finance. Its exports of services such as currency trading, insurance, law, accounting and consulting are bigger than its exports of goods.
It has world-class companies in pharmaceuticals, jet engines, defense and luxury cars. Strong university research is growing life-science and AI companies.
Since leaving the EU, paperwork and checks on trade with Europe have increased. Productivity has stagnated for years, and housing and energy costs are high.
